description: Non-destructive dry run of ownership verification for a Toolfound submission: reports, per method, what the checker sees RIGHT NOW — meta tag found or not (with the exact expected tag), DNS TXT found or not (with the exact expected record), and whether the submission email qualifies for the magic-link path. Use it to distinguish 'my deploy is not live yet' from 'wrong token' before calling toolfound_verify_submission. Changes nothing.
name: toolfound_check_verification
title: Check verification status (dry run)
